name: What types of flooring are best for a senior-friendly kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What types of flooring are best for a senior-friendly kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: For senior-friendly kitchens, non-slip, low-maintenance flooring options are ideal. Popular choices include vinyl plank flooring, which is durable, water-resistant, and offers good traction. Cork flooring is also an excellent option due to its softness, shock absorption, and natural anti-slip properties. Matte finish tiles with smaller grout lines can provide better grip than highly polished surfaces. The key is to select a material that reduces the risk of slips and falls while being comfortable to stand on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Best flooring options include non-slip vinyl plank, shock-absorbing cork, and matte finish tiles, prioritizing safety and comfort.
